## Vera 05 · 05 One reply per burst
Contractors send 20 photos in a minute. Instead of 20 replies, Vera waits until the burst goes quiet for 90 seconds and sends one summary.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: Bursts that went quiet
nodes.notes:
Claims each burst once, so two runs never send the same reply.
Guardrails: idempotent, retry

nodes.name: Compose one reply
nodes.notes: "✅ Accepted PAP-03. ↩️ PAP-04 sent back: sum insured below contract value. Still open: 6."

parameters.query: update reply_queue set sent_at = now() where id = any(($1)::bigint[]) returning id;
